stories.title: NASA Astronauts Ready for Thursday Spacewalk
stories.summary: NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Anil Menon have been given the go by mission managers for Thursday’s spacewalk to prepare the International Space Station for future upgrades to its power system. The spacewalkers will spend about seven hours in the vacuum of space building a modification kit on the station’s Starboard 6 truss segment where a roll out solar array is slated to be installed later this year. The post NASA Astronauts Ready for Thursday Spacewalk appeared first on NASA Science.

stories.title: Hidden Figures Monument in Dunbar, West Virginia
stories.summary: The Katherine Johnson Statue at West Virginia State University (WVSU) honors the legendary NASA mathematician whose brilliant calculations launched America into orbit. Unveiled on August 25, 2018—the eve of her 100th birthday—this life-sized bronze monument stands proudly at her alma mater to ensure her contributions to the Space Race are "no longer hidden". Katherine Johnson was one of the critical human "computers" at the National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics (NACA), which later became NASA. She is globally celebrated for several monumental milestones Long before Hollywood spotlighted her in the Oscar-nominated film Hidden Figures, Katherine Johnson was a math prodigy growing up in segregated West Virginia. Because local schools barred African American students past the eighth grade, her family moved 100 miles to Institute, WV so she could attend the high school on WVSU's campus at age 10.
